journal.title: My Journal
journal.keepsakesHint: Things to wear, found around the island. One per spot: head, face, neck, side, back and tail.

keepsake.queenGift: A gift from the Queen, one day.
keepsake.unfound: a place you haven't found yet

intro.title: Off I go!
intro.body: The Queen says bees used to live far beyond our meadow, a long time ago. Nobody remembers where. She gave me an empty journal and a honey snack and said: "Go and see." So I am going to see.

insideHive.title: Home, inside
insideHive.body: Warm, golden and humming. The Queen waved at me from her cushion. There is space here to build things, if I bring back enough to build with.

firstGather.title: Sticky feet
firstGather.body: I tried my first bit of gathering. It is harder than it looks and much stickier. My pouch has room for a little more, then I should fly it home.

firstGolden.title: Something golden
firstGolden.body: Out here, far from home, some flowers sparkle. Their pollen is warm and glittery and hums a tiny tune. I tucked it safely away for the Queen.

firstHoney.title: Our very first honey
firstHoney.body: The press gave a happy little squeak and out came honey. Real honey! I licked the spoon. Then I licked it again, for science.

firstNight.title: The meadow at night
firstNight.body: The sky went deep blue and the flowers folded up like little tents. Something with glowing antennae is humming over the soft grass. A Moon Bee? I should say hello.

mistLifts.title: The mist lifts
mistLifts.body: This morning the mist at the edge of the meadow was thin as a curtain. Through it: purple hills, orange trees, and the faint hum of other bees. The Queen says it is ours to explore.

theEnd.title: The end (for now)
theEnd.body: The meadow, the heath, the Amber Woods, and one very big family. The Queen says the little wishes will keep coming whenever I have time, and I think I will always have time. Thank you for flying with me.

meadow.title: Sunny meadow
meadow.body: The grass is taller here and the sun is warmer. Everything smells a little bit like honey already.

flowers.title: So many flowers
flowers.body: Pink ones, white ones, ones that wiggle when I land. I should bring a basket next time. Do bees have baskets?

forest.title: Whispering woods
forest.body: Big round trees that sway even when there is no wind. It is shady and cool. I flew a bit quieter, just to be polite.

water.title: Lily water
water.body: Cool air rises off the water. My reflection looked brave. I looked back at it bravely.

lavender.title: Lavender heath
lavender.body: Purple as far as I can see, and humming. The nectar here is sweeter and there is more of it. I may never leave. (I will leave. But slowly.)

amber.title: The Amber Woods
amber.body: Every tree is orange and gold, as if autumn lives here all year. Resin drips down the bark like honey. It is warm, and very, very quiet.

bumble.name: Bumble
bumble.blurb: Round, fuzzy and never in a hurry. Hums happily over the meadow nectar.
bumble.fled: The Bumble got shy and flew off. You'll meet another one.
bumble.journalBody: Round, fuzzy and never in a hurry. Hums happily over the meadow nectar. {name} followed me home and picked a bed straight away.

mason.name: Mason
mason.blurb: A tidy little bee in mint and teal who pats pollen into neat balls.
mason.fled: The Mason got shy and flew off. You'll meet another one.
mason.journalBody: A tidy little bee in mint and teal who pats pollen into neat balls. {name} followed me home and picked a bed straight away.

dew.name: Dew Bee
dew.blurb: Pale as morning sky, with wings that sparkle. Sips from ponds and lily water.
dew.befriendCount: Befriend a Dew Bee | Befriend {n} Dew Bees
dew.fled: The Dew Bee got shy and flew off. You'll meet another one.
dew.journalBody: Pale as morning sky, with wings that sparkle. Sips from ponds and lily water. {name} followed me home and picked a bed straight away.

carpenter.name: Carpenter
carpenter.blurb: Dark and glossy with golden stripes. Knows every sticky tree in the woods.
carpenter.fled: The Carpenter got shy and flew off. You'll meet another one.
carpenter.journalBody: Dark and glossy with golden stripes. Knows every sticky tree in the woods. {name} followed me home and picked a bed straight away.

moon.name: Moon Bee
moon.blurb: Deep blue with glowing antennae. Only hums over the soft grass at night, and flies faster than anyone.
moon.befriendCount: Befriend a Moon Bee | Befriend {n} Moon Bees
moon.fled: The Moon Bee got shy and flew off. You'll meet another one.
moon.journalBody: Deep blue with glowing antennae. Only hums over the soft grass at night, and flies faster than anyone. {name} followed me home and picked a bed straight away.

lavender.name: Lavender Bee
lavender.blurb: Soft lilac with plum stripes, and always smells faintly of the heath. The calmest bee you will ever meet.
lavender.befriendCount: Befriend a Lavender Bee | Befriend {n} Lavender Bees
lavender.fled: The Lavender Bee got shy and flew off. You'll meet another one.
lavender.journalBody: Soft lilac with plum stripes, and always smells faintly of the heath. The calmest bee you will ever meet. {name} followed me home and picked a bed straight away.

ember.name: Ember Bee
ember.blurb: Warm orange with a glowing tip on each antenna. Lives in the Amber Woods and carries resin like treasure.
ember.befriendCount: Befriend an Ember Bee | Befriend {n} Ember Bees
ember.fled: The Ember Bee got shy and flew off. You'll meet another one.
ember.journalBody: Warm orange with a glowing tip on each antenna. Lives in the Amber Woods and carries resin like treasure. {name} followed me home and picked a bed straight away.

specs.name: Explorer's Specs
specs.blurb: Round glasses hung on the old signpost. Everything looks a bit more findable.

sunflower.name: Sunflower Clip
sunflower.blurb: A baby sunflower from the giant one, for tucking by an antenna.

lilypad.name: Lily Pad Hat
lilypad.blurb: A small, springy lily pad with a flower on top. The frog insisted.

dandelion.name: Dandelion Puff
dandelion.blurb: A whole dandelion clock that somehow never blows away.

acorn.name: Acorn Cap
acorn.blurb: Left on the mossy stump's doorstep. It fits perfectly.

satchel.name: Wild Satchel
satchel.blurb: A tiny woven bag from the wild bees, for carrying good thoughts.

oldcrown.name: Ancient Crown
oldcrown.blurb: Dug from the old honeycomb. Whoever wore it was very small and very important.

mistscarf.name: Mist Scarf
mistscarf.blurb: Woven from the shimmer at the edge of the world. Cool and soft.

ribbon.name: Royal Ribbon
ribbon.blurb: The Queen's own thank-you bow, for a very helpful bee.

sprig.name: Lavender Sprig
sprig.blurb: From the cottage window box. Tucked behind an antenna, it smells like a nap.

leafcape.name: Amber Leaf Cape
leafcape.blurb: One huge glowing leaf from the Hollow Oak, worn like a little cape.

locket.name: Moon Locket
locket.blurb: A tiny silver locket from the Moonwell. It glows softly after dark.

starpin.name: Star Pin
starpin.blurb: The Queen's star, for the bee who flew further than any other.

signpost.name: Old Signpost
signpost.journalBody: Three arrows, all pointing different ways. One just says "HONEY?" with a question mark. Somebody was lost, or very hopeful.

sunflower.name: Giant Sunflower
sunflower.journalBody: A sunflower so big it has its own shadow weather. The nectar smells like warm toast. I will be back with more empty pockets.

pond.name: Quiet Pond
pond.journalBody: Lily pads big enough to nap on. A frog looked at me for a very long time and then said nothing. I think we are friends now.

dandelion.name: Dandelion Hill
dandelion.journalBody: Every step sends little parachutes floating up. I counted forty-two before I lost count and started again.

stump.name: Mossy Stump
stump.journalBody: Soft as a pillow and humming quietly. Something small lives inside. It left a crumb of wax on the doorstep, like a hello.

nest.name: Wild Nest
nest.journalBody: Another hive, out here on its own. The bees inside have stripes I have never seen. They buzzed hello in a funny accent.

honeycomb.name: Broken Honeycomb
honeycomb.journalBody: Pieces of honeycomb, very very old, half buried in the grass. The cells are bigger than ours. Who built this?

mist.name: The Mist's Edge
mist.journalBody: The meadow just... stops. Beyond is a warm, shimmering haze. My wings feel too thin to go further. Not yet, anyway.

cottage.name: Lavender Cottage
cottage.journalBody: A tiny round house with a lavender roof, and nobody home. The doormat says WELCOME, BEES in very old letters. So someone expected us.

hollowoak.name: The Hollow Oak
hollowoak.journalBody: The biggest tree I have ever seen, glowing orange all the way up. Inside it is warm and hums like our hive. Old bees lived here. I am sure of it.

moonwell.name: The Moonwell
moonwell.journalBody: A round stone well full of water so still it holds the whole sky. At night, they say, it keeps a little piece of the moon.

nectar.name: Nectar
nectar.blurb: Sweet and runny, from meadow flowers.

water.name: Water
water.blurb: Cool drops from ponds and lily water.

resin.name: Resin
resin.blurb: Sticky tree resin from the woods.

honey.name: Honey
honey.blurb: Made from nectar in the Honey Press.

wax.name: Wax
wax.blurb: For building and expanding the hive.

golden.name: Golden Pollen
golden.blurb: Sparkling pollen from far-off flowers. Only you can find it.

press.name: Honey Press
press.blurb: Slowly squeezes nectar into golden honey.

kitchen.name: Bee Bread Kitchen
kitchen.blurb: Bakes pollen and water into soft bee bread.

waxworks.name: Wax Works
waxworks.blurb: Melts resin with a little honey into building wax.

larder.name: Larder Comb
larder.blurb: Extra comb for storing more of everything.

room.name: Bee Room
room.blurb: Four snug little beds for helper bees.

sweet-start.title: A sweet start
sweet-start.ask: Could you fetch a little nectar for the Honey Press? Gather six drops from a sunny meadow and fly them home.
sweet-start.thanks: Mmm, meadow nectar. You have a good nose for flowers, little one. The press is already squeaking. Here, two jars of honey for the road.
sweet-start.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Mmm, meadow nectar. You have a good nose for flowers, little one. The press is already squeaking. Here, two jars of honey for the road."

first-honey.title: Our first honey
first-honey.ask: The Honey Press squeezes nectar into honey. Keep it fed and bring me three jars.
first-honey.thanks: Real honey, from our own press! I've had the store widened so there's room for more.
first-honey.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Real honey, from our own press! I've had the store widened so there's room for more."

first-friend.title: A friend for the hive
first-friend.ask: A hive needs more than one bee. There are wild bees out there, shy ones. I've marked the Wild Nest on your map: dance with one and bring them home.
first-friend.thanks: A new friend! Give them a job in the Colony tab. And here is some wax, for building.
first-friend.thanksBody: The Queen said: "A new friend! Give them a job in the Colony tab. And here is some wax, for building."

bee-bread.title: Bee bread for everyone
bee-bread.ask: Build a Bee Bread Kitchen and bake me two loaves. Pollen from the flower patches, water from the ponds.
bee-bread.thanks: Warm bee bread! The whole hive smells lovely. I've made the store a little bigger again.
bee-bread.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Warm bee bread! The whole hive smells lovely. I've made the store a little bigger again."

wax-walls.title: Wax for the walls
wax-walls.ask: A Wax Works turns tree resin and honey into wax. Build one and bring me four wax. (You can pause it in its panel when you'd rather keep your honey.)
wax-walls.thanks: Beautiful wax, smooth as a pebble. Keep some to unseal the old cells, and have this honey.
wax-walls.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Beautiful wax, smooth as a pebble. Keep some to unseal the old cells, and have this honey."

room-to-grow.title: Room to grow
room-to-grow.ask: Our friends need somewhere to sleep. Build a Bee Room: four snug beds.
room-to-grow.thanks: Such cosy beds. Now there's room for more friends, and I've widened the store too.
room-to-grow.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Such cosy beds. Now there's room for more friends, and I've widened the store too."

more-friends.title: A busier hive
more-friends.ask: Three friends would make the hive feel like home. Dandelion hills, ponds and woods all have their own bees.
more-friends.thanks: Listen to that happy hum! A treat for you, from all of us.
more-friends.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Listen to that happy hum! A treat for you, from all of us."

golden.title: Something golden
golden.ask: Far from home, some flowers sparkle with golden pollen, and only you can carry it. I've marked one on your map. Bring me a grain.
golden.thanks: Golden pollen! I haven't seen any since I was a tiny bee. This ribbon is yours: my own thank-you bow.
golden.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Golden pollen! I haven't seen any since I was a tiny bee. This ribbon is yours: my own thank-you bow."

old-stories.title: Old stories
old-stories.ask: My grandmother spoke of a great old honeycomb, out past the woods. I've marked where I think it is. Will you go and see?
old-stories.thanks: Bigger cells than ours, you say? Then bees really did live far beyond the meadow once. How wonderful.
old-stories.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Bigger cells than ours, you say? Then bees really did live far beyond the meadow once. How wonderful."

feast.title: A feast for the hive
feast.ask: Let's celebrate everything you've done. Twelve honey, four bee bread and three golden pollen for a hive feast!
feast.thanks: What a feast! Everyone danced until the lamps went dim. And listen: the mist at the edge of the meadow is thinning. Something is waiting out there, little explorer.
feast.thanksBody: The Queen said: "What a feast! Everyone danced until the lamps went dim. And listen: the mist at the edge of the meadow is thinning. Something is waiting out there, little explorer."

past-the-mist.title: Past the mist
past-the-mist.ask: The mist has thinned enough to fly through! Old stories speak of a little cottage in the lavender beyond it. I've marked where I think it is.
past-the-mist.thanks: A cottage that says WELCOME, BEES? Then this land was ours once, too. How lovely to be expected.
past-the-mist.thanksBody: The Queen said: "A cottage that says WELCOME, BEES? Then this land was ours once, too. How lovely to be expected."

lavender-friend.title: A friend in purple
lavender-friend.ask: Lavender Bees hum in the heath out there. Would you dance with one and bring them home?
lavender-friend.thanks: Such a calm, sweet-smelling friend. The nursery already feels sleepier.
lavender-friend.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Such a calm, sweet-smelling friend. The nursery already feels sleepier."

amber-resin.title: Amber resin
amber-resin.ask: The Amber Woods drip with the finest resin. Fly home ten, and the Wax Works will sing.
amber-resin.thanks: Glowing like little suns! This wax will be the best we've ever made.
amber-resin.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Glowing like little suns! This wax will be the best we've ever made."

hollow-oak.title: The Hollow Oak
hollow-oak.ask: Deep in the Amber Woods there is a tree so big a whole hive could live inside. I've marked it. Go and see?
hollow-oak.thanks: A hive inside a tree, humming all by itself? Then we were never really alone out here.
hollow-oak.thanksBody: The Queen said: "A hive inside a tree, humming all by itself? Then we were never really alone out here."

moonwell.title: The Moonwell
moonwell.ask: They say the Moonwell holds a piece of the moon. Visit it, and bring me three grains of golden pollen for a wish.
moonwell.thanks: I made my wish. I can't tell you what it was, but I think you'll like it.
moonwell.thanksBody: The Queen said: "I made my wish. I can't tell you what it was, but I think you'll like it."

big-family.title: One big family
big-family.ask: Our hive, the wild bees, the old hive in the oak. Let's bring everyone together: eight helpers, and a feast of twenty honey and ten wax.
big-family.thanks: Look at us all! You flew further than any bee in a hundred summers. Wear this star, little explorer. You've earned it. The little wishes will keep coming, whenever you like.
big-family.thanksBody: The Queen said: "Look at us all! You flew further than any bee in a hundred summers. Wear this star, little explorer. You've earned it. The little wishes will keep coming, whenever you like."

wishes.thanks: Thank you, dear. The hive is humming.

wb.title: Welcome back!
wb.lead: You were away for {away}. While you were gone:
wb.capped: Everyone stopped for a nap after 8 hours.

thanks.title: Thank you for playing!
thanks.quote: You flew further than any bee in a hundred summers, and brought a whole meadow home with you. The hive will hum about this for a very long time.
thanks.note: That's the whole story so far. Thank you so much for playing Hivebound: it was made with a lot of love, and I hope it gave you a few calm, happy moments. There's more to come.
thanks.noteSoft: The hive keeps going: the Queen's little wishes carry on, your helpers keep working, and every place and keepsake is still out there to enjoy.
